This role combines platform engineering, automation development, business process optimization, and production support to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions across the organization. 
 The ideal candidate brings strong technical expertise, sound engineering judgment, and a proactive mindset focused on platform reliability, user experience, and long-term maintainability. 
 Responsibilities:

Deliver moderate-to-complex enhancements and projects with controlled risk and clear communication of scope, dependencies, and trade-offs. Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, automation, and engineering velocity through reusable patterns and process improvements. Collaboration & Leadership

Participate in Agile ceremonies and coordinate work across technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.

Detail-oriented, collaborative, and adaptable in balancing technical and operational priorities.

In this role, you will build highly scalable data platforms powering  Mobile Programmatic Advertising, RTB bidding systems, attribution, campaign optimization, fraud detection, and real-time analytics . You will design and implement distributed systems capable of processing  billions of mobile advertising events every day, including  ad requests, impressions, clicks, installs, conversions, in-app events, and auction logs . You'll leverage modern Big Data technologies, cloud platforms, and Generative AI to build intelligent analytics and automation solutions. 
 You'll collaborate with Product Managers, ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and Backend Engineers to build next-generation Mobile AdTech products.   What You'll Do: Design and build highly scalable data platforms capable of processing billions of mobile advertising events with low latency and high availability.  Design and build ultra-low-latency, high-throughput data pipelines processing the full mobile event funnel — ad request impression click install in-app conversion event — including OpenRTB bid request/response logging, auction analytics, and win-rate/bid-landscape reporting across multiple SSPs and ad exchanges, using Kafka, Spark Streaming, Hadoop, and Snowflake on AWS.  Architect real-time campaign pacing and budget delivery systems, applying bid optimization techniques so spend controls and bid strategy adjustments react to live auction signals within seconds.  Architect and implement real-time streaming pipelines to ingest, process, and analyze billions of advertising events including impressions, clicks, installs, conversions, and in-app events.  Design and optimize scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data models supporting Mobile AdTech use cases such as campaign reporting, attribution, audience segmentation, fraud detection, and revenue analytics. Design large-scale Invalid Traffic (IVT) and ad fraud detection systems — click spam, install hijacking, SDK spoofing, device farms — using rules-based and ML-driven detection across billions of daily events.  Develop backend services (Java, REST APIs, JDBC) supporting DSP bidding logic, campaign management tools, and reporting APIs. 
Design and develop GenAI-powered agents for analytics, operations, and data enrichment using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, or custom orchestration frameworks.  Design systems that are highly available, fault tolerant, and optimized for low latency and high throughput.  Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to improve platform scalability, reliability, performance, and customer experience.  Work with Product Managers to define and implement new analytics capabilities and platform features.  Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, estimation, retrospectives, and release planning. Perform architecture discussions, design reviews, and peer code reviews while promoting software engineering best practices. We'd Love for You to Have:
 1–5+ years of professional experience in Java backend development and data engineering.  Strong computer science fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and software design principles.  Hands-on experience developing scalable backend services using Java, REST APIs, JDBC, and relational databases.  Strong experience building distributed data pipelines using Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, Snowflake, SQL, and AWS.  Experience designing and optimizing large-scale analytical data platforms for Mobile AdTech using Java, Spark, Kafka, Snowflake, SQL, and AWS. Strong understanding of real-time event processing, distributed data systems, and data warehouse architectures. Familiarity with distributed query engines, modern data lake technologies, and high-performance analytical databases (e.g., Trino, Presto, ClickHouse, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi) is an added advantage.  Experience processing high-volume streaming data using Spark Streaming, Kafka Streams, or similar technologies. Good understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, ETL/ELT design, and distributed computing concepts. Mobile AdTech Experience  Experience working with Mobile AdTech platforms or digital advertising ecosystems is highly preferred, including knowledge of:

Understanding of attribution methodologies (click-through, view-through, multi-touch based attribution).  Knowledge of mobile identity solutions (IDFA, GAID, IDFV) and the privacy landscape driving their deprecation.  Experience with campaign pacing, bid optimization, and budget delivery algorithms.  Background in ad fraud/IVT detection — click spam, install fraud, SDK spoofing.  Generative AI Experience  Experience building production-grade GenAI applications including:

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Job Description: Engineering Manager Mobile Applications & QA Position Title - Engineering Manager – Mobile Applications & QA Experience Required - 7–8 Years Employment Type - Full-Time Location - Pune, Onsite Department - Technology / Product Engineering Reporting To - Founder / CTO / Head of Product 
 Job Summary We are hiring an experienced Engineering Manager – Mobile Applications & QA to lead the end-to-end development, testing, delivery, and release management of a mobile-first product. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in full stack mobile app development, backend/API architecture, database planning, QA processes, testing workflows, debugging, and team leadership. This role will manage a growing technical team consisting of senior and junior full stack mobile app developers and QA engineers. The candidate must be capable of guiding both development and quality teams, reviewing technical decisions, ensuring delivery timelines, maintaining product stability, and preparing the app for production release on the Google Play Store and Apple App Store. 
 Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership Lead the complete mobile app development lifecycle from planning to deployment. Guide architecture decisions for mobile app, backend, APIs, database, admin panel, and cloud infrastructure. Review and approve technical approaches suggested by developers. Ensure scalable, secure, and maintainable code practices. Conduct code reviews and guide developers on performance, security, and best practices. Support the team in solving complex technical issues, bugs, and production blockers. Ensure the product is built with clean architecture, proper documentation, and future scalability in mind. 
 Mobile App Development Management Lead development for cross-platform mobile applications for Android and iOS. Work with technologies such as Flutter, React Native, Node.js, Firebase, Supabase, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar stacks. Oversee user authentication, role-based access, media uploads, notifications, maps, admin workflows, dashboards, and backend APIs. Ensure smooth integration between mobile app, backend systems, admin panel, and third-party services. Manage app store readiness, including production builds, release testing, deployment, version control, and post-launch fixes. 
 QA & Testing Leadership Define QA strategy, test plans, test cases, bug reporting formats, and regression testing processes. Guide QA engineers on functional testing, API testing, mobile app testing, admin panel testing, performance checks, and security/privacy validation. Ensure critical flows are properly tested before release. Maintain testing discipline across Android, iOS, and web/admin environments. Review bug severity, priority, and release impact. Ensure no critical or high-priority bugs move into production. 
 Project Delivery & Team Management Plan development sprints, task allocation, timelines, and delivery milestones. Coordinate between developers, QA engineers, designers, product/business teams, and management. Conduct daily standups, sprint reviews, technical discussions, and delivery checkpoints. Track task progress, blockers, bug status, and release readiness. Mentor senior and junior team members. Maintain accountability across the development and QA team. Ensure timelines are met without compromising product stability. 
 Product & Business Alignment Understand business requirements and convert them into clear technical execution plans. Help define MVP scope, feature priorities, and development phases. Identify technical risks early and suggest practical solutions. Balance speed, quality, cost, and scalability. Ensure the product supports future enhancements and expansion. 
 Required Skills 7–8 years of total experience in software/mobile app development and technical team leadership. Strong experience in full stack mobile app development. Hands-on experience with Flutter or React Native. Strong backend/API development understanding. Experience with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Firebase, or Supabase. Experience managing Android and iOS app development. Understanding of app deployment on Google Play Store and Apple App Store. Strong knowledge of REST APIs, authentication, role-based access control, and third-party integrations. Good understanding of QA processes, test planning, bug tracking, regression testing, and release testing. Experience working with QA engineers and debugging production issues. Strong knowledge of Git, version control, build management, and deployment workflows. Ability to review code, architecture, database structure, and API design. Experience working with tools such as Jira, ClickUp, Trello, GitHub, Postman, Firebase, Supabase, or similar tools. Strong communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills. 
 Preferred Skills Prior experience managing mobile app products from scratch. Experience working on marketplace, listing, CRM, SaaS, real estate, fintech, logistics, or lead-generation platforms. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Firebase, Supabase, or DigitalOcean. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for mobile app deployment. Basic understanding of UI/UX flows for mobile apps. Experience with data privacy, secure document handling, user verification, and access-controlled systems. Exposure to automation testing will be an added advantage. Ability to hire, train, mentor, and evaluate technical team members. 
 Key Deliverables Stable and scalable mobile app development process. Clear technical architecture and documentation. Timely sprint execution and feature delivery. Strong QA process with structured test plans and bug tracking. Production-ready Android and iOS app releases. Clean developer and QA coordination. Reduced bugs, faster debugging, and better release confidence. Strong technical governance across the product team. 
 Qualification Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience in mobile app development and technical leadership will also be considered.
